abstract: The prospective study, carried out from February 1992 to January 1996, included 49 patients in clinical Stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors (NSGCTT). They were aged 16-40 years (mean, 25 years). Patients were stratified to different risk-adapted therapeutic approaches according to histopathologic findings of primary tumor removed by inguinal orchiectomy. Eleven patients of the 1st group with vascular invasion and majority of embryonal carcinoma components in the primary tumor were treated with adjuvant chemotherapy (2 cycles of BEP). None of them had disease progression after the follow-up of 4-43+ months (mean, 20.9 months) after orchiectomy. Five patients of the 2nd group with vascular invasion and majority of teratoma elements in the primary tumor were treated with primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND). They were followed-up 29-45+ months (mean, 33.4 months) after orchiectomy. Two of them (40%) had pathologic Stage II after RPLND and underwent subsequent BEP chemotherapy. One of them died due to disease progression in disseminated stage 29 months after orchiectomy. The second one lives with no evidence of the disease (NED). Thirty three patients in the 3rd group without vascular invasion were kept under surveillance. They were followed-up 3-48+ months (mean, 22.3 months) after orchiectomy. Disease progression was observed in 5 of them (15.1%), 7-10 months (mean, 8.8 months) following orchiectomy. These patients were treated with BEP chemotherapy and live with NED 1-16+ months (mean, 9.2 months) after completion of the therapy. The overall survival rate in clinical Stage 1 patients was 97.9%. The authors recommend the surveillance policy only in clinical Stage I NSGCTT patients without vascular invasion in the primary tumor.
abstract_ja:
1992年2月から1996年1月まで実施された前向き研究には、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞精巣腫瘍(NSGCTT)の患者49例が含まれた。年齢は16〜40歳(平均25歳)であった。患者は、鼠径部精巣摘除術で摘出された原発腫瘍の病理組織所見に応じて、リスクに基づく異なる治療法に層別化された。
脈管侵襲があり、原発腫瘍に胎児性癌成分が大部分を占める第1群の患者11例は、補助化学療法(BEP 2サイクル)を受けた。精巣摘除術後4〜43+か月(平均20.9か月)の経過観察で、いずれも病勢進行はなかった。
脈管侵襲があり、原発腫瘍に奇形腫成分が大部分を占める第2群の患者5例は、一次的後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を受けた。精巣摘除術後29〜45+か月(平均33.4か月)の経過観察を行った。このうち2例(40%)はRPLND後に病理学的病期II(Stage II)となり、その後BEP化学療法を受けた。1例は精巣摘除術後29か月で播種性病期の病勢進行により死亡した。もう1例は無病生存(NED)している。
脈管侵襲のない第3群の患者33例は経過観察を受けた。精巣摘除術後3〜48+か月(平均22.3か月)の経過観察を行った。このうち5例(15.1%)で精巣摘除術後7〜10か月(平均8.8か月)に病勢進行が認められた。これらの患者はBEP化学療法で治療され、治療終了後1〜16+か月(平均9.2か月)の時点で無病生存している。
臨床病期I患者の全生存率は97.9%であった。著者らは、原発腫瘍に脈管侵襲のない臨床病期I NSGCTT患者に限って、サーベイランス方針を推奨している。
